briefdescription.para: Fluent builder for constructing and configuring an IngestionManager.

detaileddescription.para: Provides a convenient, chainable API to register sources and configure behaviour before running ingestion.

Example usage: automgr=IngestionBuilder("my_db") .withHuggingFaceSource("hf_legal","lexlms/ger_legal_data", {{"split","train"},{"streaming","true"}}) .withFilesystemSource("custom_docs","/mnt/documents", {{"recursive","true"}}) .withRetryConfig({.max_attempts=5,.initial_delay_ms=200.0}) .withParallelProcessing(true,4) .withTargetCollection("legal_documents") .build();
autoreport=mgr->ingestAll();
